_doc: Pangolin v2 — operator-tunable config. Wallet/chatId/decision_model resolved from env vars at runtime install (${WALLET_ADDRESS}, ${TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}, ${PANGOLIN_DECISION_MODEL}); do NOT hardcode here. Risk gates, leverage caps, and asset cooldowns are enforced by the runtime via runtime.yaml and the producer's hardcoded constants.

leverage._note: v1.4 carryover. 3x default — crowded unwinds are violent. Producer constants WIN; this is informational/audit only.

marginPct._note: 25% of account value per slot. Override per-deploy via PANGOLIN_MARGIN_PCT env var.

entry._minFundingRate_note: Per-hour rate (HL funding is hourly) ≈ 20% annualized. Live gate is the producer's MIN_FUNDING_RATE constant; this mirrors it. v3.0.1 recalibrated from 0.00015 (which was ~131% ann under hourly cadence).
entry._note: These mirror pangolin-producer.py's hardcoded constants. Producer constants WIN — config is informational/audit only in v2.

dynamicDailyCap._note: Producer-side PnL-aware daily cap (v1 carryover). Runtime guard_rails.max_entries_per_day=12 is the upper ceiling.

_runtime_owns._doc: These were v1 concerns. In v2, the runtime owns them via runtime.yaml.guard_rails. DO NOT add gates here.
_runtime_owns.execution.exitOrderType: runtime.exit.order_type (FEE_OPTIMIZED_LIMIT — v2 maker-exit recovery, ensure_execution_as_taker:true as safety floor)
